Bengal Girl's Autopsy Reveals Sexual Assault and Violent Death

An autopsy of a girl found in a sack in West Bengal has revealed evidence of sexual assault and a fatal head injury. The findings suggest she was alive when thrown into the water, with excessive bleeding from the head wound noted. The case highlights a violent end for the young victim.
